name: heavensent
source:
The year is 1930. After a traumatic incident, Odette has been sent away to a Catholic boarding school for young ladies. However, there's one secret she has to keep hidden: she's a recently-turned vampyre. 

Determined to continue life as a normal human, Odette tries her best to navigate the changes within her body and appetite. Luckily, she doesn't have to do it alone. Her roommate, Auriame, is by her side, but is withholding her own secrets. Together, will their friendship blossom into something beautiful, or become something all-consuming?

[From [url=https://imcoffeecats.itch.io/heavensent]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1930年，经历了一次创伤事件后，奥黛特被送往一所为年轻女子开设的天主教寄宿学校。然而，她必须隐藏一个秘密：她是一名最近变成的吸血鬼。

奥黛特决心继续像正常人一样生活，她尽最大努力应对身体和食欲的变化。幸运的是，她不必独自完成这件事。她的室友奥里亚姆就在她身边，但她隐瞒了自己的秘密。他们的友谊会一起绽放出美丽的花朵，还是变得令人倾心？

[来自[url=https://imcoffeecats.itch.io/heavensent]Itch.io[/url]]
